acceptance: Static HTML tables (TABLE-001) and ARIA grids (TABLE-002) share one extraction composite; both pass positive, negative and adversarial fixtures and held-out seeds from two generators, and the claim fails when a witness is altered.

positive.fixture: both tables reuse collection.extract and agree on held-out seeds
positive.command: cargo test --manifest-path compiler/Cargo.toml --locked -p vsf-registry --test harness -- both_tables_share_one_composition two_independent_sources_yield_the_same_semantics_on_held_out_seeds every_fixture_passes_the_shared_composite

negative.fixture: a CSS grid lookalike is not a collection and changed expectations fail the fixture

security_and_source_permissions: Registry data carries no credentials; no real source app was observed, and source-account permissions stay outside the registry.
performance_memory_storage: Extraction is a single pass over the fixture node list.
known_limitations: Both families are synthetic and written by the same authors, so both stay implemented, not conformant
